traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are fully met.
Mapping to acceptance criteria: - Before Other Tags / After Other Tags / Mixed Positions: Implemented via `isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine` and the `processCommentLine` boundary logic; covered by dedicated valid tests showing @story/@req before, after, and interleaved with @param/@returns tags. - Proper Termination / JSDoc Tag Detection / Continuation Lines: Any line starting with `@` (except @story/@req/@supports) is detected as a JSDoc boundary, finalizing pending annotations and preventing continuation onto those lines; continuation only occurs on non-tag lines. Tests include multi-line @story values followed by @param and verify they remain valid. - Error Messages / No False Positives: The previous bug where the requirement ID was concatenated with `@param` content is explicitly regression-tested and now passes as valid, demonstrating that valid annotations are no longer misinterpreted. - Backward Compatible: All existing annotation-format tests (including multi-line and @supports/multi-story behavior) continue to pass, so the new logic did not break prior valid patterns. - Documentation / Tests: The rule documentation has a specific "JSDoc coexistence" section with examples tied to this story, and the Jest suite includes comprehensive tests for the described JSDoc tag combinations.
Given the implemented parser behavior, exhaustive tests, updated documentation, and passing test suite, this story is fully implemented and verified.
